verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships Post-Incident Reviews (formerly Jeli) that you can start from the incident page or Slack after resolution. They draw on incident lifecycle data, Slack data and Scribe Agent call transcripts to build chronological narratives, AI-generated PIRs are GA, and the docs mention coordinating follow-up actions. That covers the drafting-from-timeline part of the story, but the rest of the workflow is not evidenced. Missing for 10: PIR templates, a review/approval step, a publication/sharing workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
